quest.q001.name: First Tree
quest.q001.desc: Your fragment is quiet, but a lone tree still stands. Its wood is the first thing the world gives back. Break 8 logs.
quest.q002.name: Planks
quest.q003.name: Workbench
quest.q003.desc: Survivors have always built before they understood. Craft a crafting table.
quest.q004.name: Sticks
quest.q005.name: Wooden Pickaxe
quest.q006.name: Pebbles
quest.q006.desc: The stone of Aethelgard is scarce here: the Devourer left only dust and pebbles. Right-click the ground of your island with an empty hand to pick up 9 Stone Pebbles.
quest.q007.name: First Cobblestone
quest.q008.name: Stone Pickaxe
quest.q009.name: Wooden Sword
quest.q010.name: Plant a Sapling
quest.q011.name: First Harvest
quest.q012.name: Bread
quest.q013.name: The Fountain
quest.q013.desc: An old memory stirs in the rock: the Call. You remember how to shape a Fountain. Craft a Fountain from 4 cobblestone and 4 logs.
quest.q014.name: Place the Fountain
quest.q014.desc: Place your Fountain on your island. It makes a cobblestone above itself every 2 seconds.
quest.q015.name: Fountain Cobble
quest.q016.name: Fountain Cobble II
quest.q017.name: Read the Plan
quest.q018.name: Spring Stone
quest.q018.desc: Place the Spring Stone on the south side of your Fountain's ring.
quest.q019.name: Stone Bricks
quest.q019.desc: Get 16 stone bricks: craft them from stone, or use a stonecutter.
quest.q020.name: The Ring
quest.q020.desc: Place 7 stone bricks around your Fountain (the Spring Stone takes the south side).
quest.q021.name: Stone Generator
quest.q021.desc: The ring closes and the fragment breathes again. Complete the ring: your Fountain becomes a Stone generator (right-click it to check what is missing).
quest.q022.name: Mine the Generator
quest.q023.name: Iron Nugget
quest.q023.desc: Find your first iron nugget in your generator.
quest.q024.name: Nugget Stash
quest.q024.desc: Find 9 iron nuggets in your generator.
quest.q025.name: Iron Ingot
quest.q026.name: First Bucket
quest.q027.name: Bottomless Water
quest.q027.desc: Fill your bucket from the Spring Stone.
quest.q028.name: Copper
quest.q028.desc: Find 16 raw copper in your generator.
quest.q029.name: Coal
quest.q030.name: Gold
quest.q030.desc: Find a gold nugget in your generator.
quest.q031.name: Bronze Age
quest.q031.desc: Bronzite, the first metal the Call taught the survivors. Your journey beyond the islet begins. Find your first Bronzite in your generator.
quest.q032.name: Mine 250
quest.q033.name: Mine 500
quest.q034.name: Smelter
quest.q035.name: Storage
quest.q036.name: Iron Pickaxe
quest.q037.name: Visit the Market
quest.q038.name: First Sales
quest.q039.name: Dune Plan
quest.q039.desc: Read the plans of the other generators with /guide.
quest.q040.name: Sandstone
quest.q041.name: Dune Ring
quest.q041.desc: Place 7 sandstone blocks around a second Fountain (a Spring Stone on the south side).
quest.q042.name: Dune Generator
quest.q042.desc: Complete the sandstone ring: a Dune generator makes sand, gravel and red sand.
quest.q043.name: Sand
quest.q044.name: Gravel
quest.q045.name: Red Sand
quest.q046.name: Glass
quest.q046.desc: Smelt 8 glass: put sand in a furnace and take the glass out.
quest.q047.name: Concrete
quest.q048.name: More Glass
quest.q048.desc: Smelt 16 more glass (stained glass counts too).
quest.q049.name: Frost Ring
quest.q049.desc: Place 7 glass blocks around a third Fountain (a Spring Stone on the south side).
quest.q050.name: Frost Generator
quest.q050.desc: Complete the glass ring: a Frost generator makes snow blocks, packed ice and Frostium.
quest.q051.name: Snow
quest.q052.name: Ice
quest.q053.name: Frostium
quest.q053.desc: Find your first Frostium in the blocks of your Frost generator.
quest.q054.name: Frostium Haul
quest.q054.desc: Find 8 Frostium in the blocks of your Frost generator.
quest.q055.name: Second Spring
quest.q056.name: More Fountains
quest.q057.name: The Forge
quest.q057.desc: The Forge is the heart of every survivor camp: it turns raw memory into tools. Craft a Forge with a blast furnace, 4 iron ingots and 4 coal, then place it.
quest.q058.name: Open the Forge
quest.q059.name: First Forging
quest.q059.desc: Collect a Bronze Core from the Forge (/forge).
quest.q060.name: Raise the Generator
quest.q060.desc: Reach generator tier II: forge a Bronze Core and right-click it on your island.
